card.name: Section heading ends in warnings text
card.fires_on: The last word or colon of a section heading in a drug label's Warnings and Precautions or Indications, just before the first sentence of the body text begins. Also fires on commas, periods and linking words inside the first sentences.

modes.label: End of heading
modes.description: The final heading word or colon right before the body text starts.
modes.example: Left Ventricular Dysfunction<<:>> MARGENZA may lead to reductions

modes.label: Inside opening sentence
modes.description: A comma, period or linking verb within an early warning sentence.
modes.example: The definition of immune-mediated hepatitis<< included>> the required use of systemic corticoster

card.writes: Weak and mixed; it slightly favors formal, descriptive continuations such as 'comprised' and 'prior' and suppresses casual words like 'things' and 'stuff'.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label's warning heading finishes and the explanatory text begins.
